title: LogSource
description: A way logs reach Guardian, backed by a Guardian ingest token of the same type. The token is minted on create and shown once, by the apply that creates it; it is never exported or shown in a plan. aws: the token for the vulnetix-siem CloudFormation stack you deploy (IngestToken), which sends VPC flow logs, Route 53 Resolver logs and CloudTrail events by Firehose. cloudflare: Guardian creates Logpush jobs with your Cloudflare API token, which is used for those calls only and never stored. events: the token for POST /v1/ingest/events, used by your own scripts and the Vulnetix runtime sensor. Guardian has no update for a token or a Logpush job, so a changed spec is applied as delete and create: the old token is revoked and a new one minted. Managing sources needs the Guardian manager role.

label.description: The token's label on the Sources page. Defaults to the type and the date.

cloudflare.description: The Logpush jobs to create. Running it again does not make a second job for a dataset that already sends to Guardian. Cloudflare allows four Logpush jobs per zone.

apiToken.description: Where the client reads the Cloudflare API token. Sent for this apply only; Guardian never stores it, so deleting the source needs it again.

datasets.description: firewall_events, http_requests and dns_logs are zone datasets, created on every zone the token can see (or those in zoneIds). The others are account datasets and need accountId.

accountId.description: The Cloudflare account id, for account datasets.

zoneIds.description: Only these zones. Left out, every zone the token can see (at most 1,000).
